name: Chakra-Enhanced Fortitude (Akashic)
body:
You can use akasha to strengthen your blood and harden your internal organs. You boost your ability to resist effects that would adversely affect your health.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or veilweaver level 1.

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. You gain an insight bonus on Fortitude saves equal to the invested essence.

You gain 1 point of essence.
